review_notes: I reviewed the whole file (lines 1–53) and the `norm_coe` simp lemma in Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Group/Completion.lean. The six lemmas are all oriented to remove the completion coercion, so each rewrite terminates and none can cycle. The Θ lemmas are derived from the O lemmas. A combined case with the coercion on both sides is covered by applying the left and right lemmas one after the other. I grepped for uses of these lemmas and found none outside this file, so I had no concrete downstream simp failure to point to. The only possible gap is that the lemmas are stated for the lambda form `fun x ↦ (g x : F̂)`. They would not match a `Function.comp` form such as `(↑) ∘ g`. I found no evidence that this form occurs in practice, so I am not reporting it.
